purpose: Additional source-backed global and remote evidence for emerging domains. This layer is intentionally separate from Nigerian evidence and does not assert Nigerian demand or licensing.

policy.nigeria: Do not relabel these records as Nigerian evidence.
policy.remote: Global evidence can inform portable or remote pathways, but it is not proof of a remote vacancy or eligibility.
policy.priority: Priority labels are within the cited framework or profile and are not universal rankings.
policy.licensing: No licence or statutory requirement is inferred from these sources.
